guide.brasshaven.ores.title: Ores & brass
guide.brasshaven.pale_dunes.p0: A white desert of pale sand rippled with gold, smooth sandstone underneath. Banded terracotta hoodoos stand like chimneys between the dunes, some with a sandstone cap. Husks, camels and desert villages are at home here too.
guide.brasshaven.pale_dunes.p1: Where: the driest deserts (about one desert in four).
guide.brasshaven.pale_dunes.title: Pale Dunes
guide.brasshaven.path.p0: 1. Meet a Guild Agent: the nearest Guild Outpost is marked on your map (a village's Guild Post works too). Lost the mark? Use the Atlas: it shows the way again until you get there.
guide.brasshaven.path.p1: 2. His first contract: bring 12 bread. 3. The second: survey a Ruined Watchtower (he marks one on your map). Your reward: the Structure Compass, to find every other structure.
guide.brasshaven.path.p2: 4. With Map Fragments from structures: a waystone, a backpack, the Cartographer's Blade and the Explorer set. 5. Below y = 0, Lithite: its gear, and more compasses. 6. The Nether, then the End.
guide.brasshaven.path.p3: Each player earns the compass from the contracts for themselves, even on a server where the others went far ahead.
guide.brasshaven.path.title: The road ahead
guide.brasshaven.peoples.p0: The great places are not empty any more: dwarves, sylvans, clockwork citizens and monks live in them, and each hostile place has its own creature, with its own trick.
guide.brasshaven.peoples.p1: Trading: right-click a resident to open the trading screen. Each trade has its stock; it comes back after a while. Guards do not trade: they answer with a few words.
guide.brasshaven.peoples.p2: Guards attack the monsters that come near their home, and anyone who hurts a resident: hit one and the guards around turn on you, and nobody will trade with you for a few minutes.
guide.brasshaven.peoples.p3: Residents stay home, never despawn and heal slowly. They flee from monsters. No monster spawns on its own inside their homes.
guide.brasshaven.peoples.title: Living places
guide.brasshaven.pilgrims_ascent.p0: A 124-block fang of rock with a sheer north face over a plunge pool; up its south flank a switchback stairway of almost 500 steps, sixteen red gates and a lantern on every landing, to a bell temple on the summit.
guide.brasshaven.pilgrims_ascent.p1: Where: meadows, groves, snowy slopes, stony peaks and windswept hills.
guide.brasshaven.pilgrims_ascent.p2: Shrines on the way: prayer wheels, a waterfall, the bell cave (waystone), the wind-bridge to a needle pinnacle, the hermit's cell (look under the floor). A site of grace waits before the temple; the hall is the arena and the reward hangs over the cliff behind it. The way down: jump from its balcony into the pool.
guide.brasshaven.pilgrims_ascent.title: Pilgrim's Ascent
guide.brasshaven.pneumatic_post.p0: Every Pneumatic Post opens your own inbox: letters and parcels from other players, contract deliveries and items given back. Select one to read it; Take items puts in your bag what fits and leaves the rest.
guide.brasshaven.pneumatic_post.p1: Write tab: type the name of any player who ever joined (Tab completes it), a letter, and up to 6 stacks in the parcel slots. Postage: 1 brass nugget, plus 1 per stack. The parcel arrives at once, even if they are offline.
guide.brasshaven.pneumatic_post.p2: Craft: brass ingots around glass, two copper ingots and a chest.
guide.brasshaven.pneumatic_post.title: Pneumatic Post
guide.brasshaven.quests.p0: Open the journal with J or by using the Wayfarer's Atlas. Five chapters lead you from the first Guild Outpost to the End; each quest shows its objective, your progress and its rewards.
guide.brasshaven.quests.p1: The card at the top-right of your screen follows the road ahead: the next step you have not done, quests and contracts alike. Click Track to pin another quest instead; when it is done, the card goes back to the next step by itself.
guide.brasshaven.quests.p2: Progress is shared: when a friend completes a step, it counts for the whole group, even offline players. Every quest also gives talent points.
guide.brasshaven.quests.title: Quests & journal
guide.brasshaven.radar.p0: The creatures around you show on the minimap (and on the world map zoomed in): their face, or a dot - red hostile, green animal, yellow neutral; villagers and NPCs a badge, bosses a purple crowned skull. A small tick: far above or below. Other players: their head and where they look, gold for companions.
guide.brasshaven.radar.p1: The radar's options are in the gear panel (Radar column) or Mods > Brasshaven > Config, Radar tab: on or off, faces or dots, and which kinds to show (hostile, animals, NPCs, players, items).
guide.brasshaven.radar.title: Minimap radar
guide.brasshaven.recall.p0: Use it to return instantly to the nearest waystone of your dimension. It is used up.
guide.brasshaven.recall.p1: Elites sometimes drop one. Craft 2 with paper, a Map Fragment and an ender pearl.
guide.brasshaven.recall.title: Recall Scroll
guide.brasshaven.recipes.p0: Beside every inventory sits the list of all items, Brasshaven's first. Search a name, @mod or #tag; the wheel turns its pages. I shows or hides it.
guide.brasshaven.recipes.p1: Over an item, in a slot or the list: R shows how to make it, U what it is used for (in the list: left or right click). One tab per way of making: crafting, furnaces, stonecutter, Chisel Table...
guide.brasshaven.recipes.p2: Click an ingredient for its own recipes; Backspace goes back. The book button opens the item's manual page.
guide.brasshaven.recipes.p3: From a crafting table, your inventory or a furnace, the + button moves the ingredients into the grid (Shift: as many as possible). What you lack is red.
guide.brasshaven.recipes.title: Recipe viewer
guide.brasshaven.redstone_easy.p0: Redstone Timer: a ready-made clock. Its screen has a slider for the interval (0.5 s to 1 minute), the pulse length, a redstone mode to pause it, and a bar counting down to the next pulse.
guide.brasshaven.redstone_easy.p1: Tree farm in 3 blocks: Timer -> Block Breaker facing the trunk -> Block Placer with saplings below it. Their screens show the block they will break or place next, and where the items go.
guide.brasshaven.redstone_easy.p2: Wireless Transmitter and Receiver: pick the same colour among the 16 swatches of their screens (or use a dye on them) and the signal travels without wires; the screen counts the transmitters and receivers on that channel.
guide.brasshaven.redstone_easy.p3: Entity Detector: pick what it looks for (players, monsters, animals, items or all creatures) and how far; it outputs 1 per creature (max 15), or the opposite when inverted: on while nothing is near.
guide.brasshaven.redstone_easy.title: Easy redstone
guide.brasshaven.refill.p0: When the stack in your hand runs out (last block placed, last food eaten, tool broken), the next stack of the same item from your inventory takes its place by itself.
guide.brasshaven.refill.title: Hotbar refill
guide.brasshaven.remembrance.p0: Every boss drops its Remembrance. Craft it with four materials of its region (Map Fragments, Lithite, Ancient Embers or Void Shards) and two diamonds to forge its unique weapon, with a special right-click power.
guide.brasshaven.remembrance.title: Boss weapons
guide.brasshaven.rift_sentinel.p0: A floating obsidian obelisk with a single violet eye. Its rune tablets lock in front of the eye while a dotted line points at you: then the beam hits and drags you toward it, so never fight it on a ledge. Stay out of the line of sight to dodge. Hit it a few times and it blinks away. Found in the End archives, observatories, wrecks and gardens.
guide.brasshaven.rift_sentinel.title: Rift Sentinel
guide.brasshaven.rivet_gun.p0: Right-click to fire a hot rivet: 5 damage, fast and nearly straight. Ammo: Rivets from your inventory, or iron nuggets.
guide.brasshaven.rivet_gun.p1: Craft: three brass ingots, a copper ingot, a piston and a plank. 12 Rivets: an iron ingot, a copper ingot and a zinc nugget.
guide.brasshaven.rivet_gun.title: Rivet Gun
guide.brasshaven.rock_necropolis.p0: A rose-red sandstone massif carved like Petra and Abu Simbel: a winding slot canyon opens on a hidden court where four 42-block seated kings flank an 18-block portal.
guide.brasshaven.rock_necropolis.p2: Behind the hypostyle hall, three levels of tombs go down: embalming rooms, a flooded gallery, a trapped corridor (mind the pressure plates) and the treasury. A site of grace waits before the king's arena; the King's Well climbs from the vault back to the hall.
guide.brasshaven.rock_necropolis.title: Necropolis of Kings
guide.brasshaven.rust_mite.p0: The brood of the Rust Mite Swarm-Mother: a flake of rust on six needle legs. Tiny, fast and frail; it rears and spreads its mandibles before it bites, and crumbles away after a minute. Found in the Fallen Colossus.
guide.brasshaven.rust_mite.title: Rust Mite
guide.brasshaven.rust_mite_mother.p0: A tick with an enormous swollen abdomen of flaking rust, nesting in the Fallen Colossus. Its bite corrodes your armour. Its abdomen pumps three times while it rears before it spits a gobbet of rust that slows and weakens you. Once, it plants its legs while its abdomen swells and shudders, its pores glowing: kill it fast or step back, for its brood bursts out, two or three tiny rust mites. Found in the Fallen Colossus.
guide.brasshaven.rust_mite_mother.title: Rust Mite Swarm-Mother
guide.brasshaven.sea_floor.p0: Pearl Oysters lie in beds in temperate and warm seas. Right-click an open shell to take its pearl; it grows a new one in time. Four pearls trade for an emerald at the crafting table.
guide.brasshaven.sea_floor.p1: Bubble vents rise from basalt chimneys: swim into the column to shoot up to the surface and breathe. Glow Anemones light the floor at night; pick them up to decorate an aquarium.
guide.brasshaven.sea_floor.title: The sea floor
guide.brasshaven.sea_serpent.p0: At night, over deep water, a boat or a swimmer may draw the Sea Serpent: a long crested beast with a boss bar. It bites, lunges from afar (boats in its way break) and roars up a whirlpool that drags you in and tips riders into the sea.
guide.brasshaven.sea_serpent.p1: Fight it from a solid spot or under water with a Diving Helmet. It drops Sea Serpent Scales, prismarine and sometimes a Heart of the Sea. Unfought, it sinks away at dawn.
guide.brasshaven.sea_serpent.title: Sea Serpent
guide.brasshaven.shattered_halo.p0: A tilted ring of purpur, end stone bricks and gold, 170 blocks across, broken into five arcs floating at different heights over the void of the End, with a temple on each arc and the boss on a disc at the centre.
guide.brasshaven.shattered_halo.p1: Where: the outer islands of the End (highlands, midlands, barrens, small islands), over open void.
guide.brasshaven.shattered_halo.p2: Arrive on the outer islet (waystone); the bridges set the order: the Observatory, a light bridge to the Library of the Void, stepping islets to the Reliquary (a trapdoor hides a crypt), an arched bridge to the Bell Shrine, a light bridge down to the Gate. The radial bridge leads to a site of grace, then to the arena. A fall off a walkway means the void: bring ender pearls and slow falling.
guide.brasshaven.shattered_halo.title: Shattered Halo
guide.brasshaven.sky_harbour.p0: A steam airship moored at the top of a 44-block iron tower, seen from far away.
guide.brasshaven.sky_harbour.p1: Where: plains, meadows, savannas and hills. The Airship Compass points to the nearest one.
guide.brasshaven.sky_harbour.p2: Climb the tower to the docking arm to board the ship: deck, cabin, propeller and engines. Bring the Grappling Hook and the Brass Glider.
guide.brasshaven.sky_harbour.title: Sky Harbour
guide.brasshaven.sky_isles.p0: An archipelago of floating islands linked by rope bridges: waterfalls, a giant cherry tree, a ruined watchtower, aether crystals and a ruined shrine with the treasure altar.
guide.brasshaven.sky_isles.p1: Where: high above oceans, plains and meadows (from about y 170 to y 230).
guide.brasshaven.sky_isles.p2: To get up: pillar up with blocks, use the Grappling Hook or a levitation wand. The Brass Glider brings you back down safely. Beware the gargoyle in the tower.
guide.brasshaven.sky_isles.title: Sky Isles
guide.brasshaven.sky_raider.p0: A wind pirate on clockwork wings. It circles above you, shrieks, then dives to snatch you in its talons and carry you up before letting go. Hit it while it holds you and it drops you at once; sneak to break free. If its dive misses, it crashes and stays stunned: punish it. Found on the Sky Isles.
guide.brasshaven.sky_raider.title: Sky Raider
guide.brasshaven.slag_golem.p0: A hunched heap of basalt and cooled slag poured out of the Forge of the Basalt Titan, glowing seams running through it and fists of still-molten slag. It is slow, but every blow leaves a puddle of cooling slag on the floor that burns whoever stands in it for a few seconds: fight it on the move. It drags its right fist back past its hip while the fist flares before a burning haymaker, and heaves both fists over its head, slag dripping, before slamming the floor in front of it. From afar it claws a gobbet of slag off its shoulder and swings it back: the spot it aims at smokes, and the gobbet splashes there a moment later. Found in the Forge of the Basalt Titan.
guide.brasshaven.slag_golem.title: Slag Golem
guide.brasshaven.sluice_drowned.p0: The drowned lock-keeper of the Great Aqueduct, in a sou'wester and waders, a boat-hook taller than himself in his fist. He raises the hook and whirls it over his hat before casting it at you from up to seven blocks away: it hooks you and hauls you to his feet, so break his line of sight or step aside. Up close he draws the pole back along his arm before jabbing with the spike, and swings it out wide behind him before a low sweep that knocks you off your feet. He swims and breathes under water. Found in the Great Aqueduct.
guide.brasshaven.sluice_drowned.title: Sluice Drowned
guide.brasshaven.solar_hierarch.p0: In the sun chamber under the lens of the Sun-Engine Ziggurat, past the antechamber and the mist, the last priest of the noon keeps watch (620 health, armour 12): a tall gilded automaton in a striped headdress, a brass sun-disc halo at his back with three little planets wheeling round it, a sun-staff in his right hand and a mirror-shield on his left arm. When the fight starts six sandstone gnomons rise round the floor: they are your cover, because no light of his passes through them.
guide.brasshaven.solar_hierarch.p1: His mirror guards his front against blows and throws arrows back at the archer: hit him from the side or behind, or keep hitting the mirror until it cracks and he reels (he then takes more damage). Strike the mirror three times quickly and he bashes you away with it. He sweeps, thrusts with fire and chains a three-hit combo that ends in a slam. When the mirror flares, look away or stand behind a gnomon: the flash blinds.
guide.brasshaven.solar_hierarch.title: The Solar Hierarch
At 30% he calls the eclipse: the room goes dark (only his halo and the beam stay lit), a burst knocks you back and he grows faster. Six sun-sigils light up round the floor; every few seconds he blinks between them, and the next one to flare is the one he lands on: a corona of fire bursts round him there, so keep away from the bright sigil. A lone pillar of light wanders the room all the while.

His Remembrance, four Map Fragments and two diamonds forge the Sun-Staff of the Solar Hierarch, whose right-click looses a ray of sunlight that glances off walls up to three times and burns every foe it crosses.
guide.brasshaven.solar_hierarch_sun.p0: He calls down the sun-lance: a beam falls down the shaft, bounces off his mirror and crawls after you; a gnomon stops it. He spins his planets in rings round the room: jump the low ring, duck behind a gnomon for the high one. Below 65% he leaps onto you, sends rings of fire and adds a second beam and a third ring whose turn reverses (blue chevrons warn you).
guide.brasshaven.sorting.p0: Press R to sort your main inventory (not the hotbar or armour): stacks are merged and grouped.
guide.brasshaven.sorting.title: Inventory sorting
guide.brasshaven.sorting_chest.p0: A big 54-slot chest that sorts itself when nobody is looking inside, and vacuums items dropped within 6 blocks.
guide.brasshaven.sorting_chest.p1: Sneak-right-click to sort it right now. Put one next to your mob farm or your mine entrance.
guide.brasshaven.sorting_chest.p2: Craft: a chest, a hopper and seven planks.
guide.brasshaven.sorting_chest.title: Sorting Chest
guide.brasshaven.soul_engine.p0: A machine-ossuary 178 by 195 blocks on a Nether valley floor: a cathedral-sized engine block of blackstone and tarnished brass fed by bone conveyors, six colossal pistons frozen at different heights, ribbed chimneys venting blue flame, warped fungus eating its walls. Where: soul sand valleys, warped forests.
guide.brasshaven.soul_engine.p1: From the pilgrims' camp (waystone), under the ribcage arch to the bone gate and the pressure hall (waystone). North: bone hoppers, the soul-soil bunker, the soul furnace; up its stair to the stokers' mess, the governor's control room and the valve room, then up the piston shaft to the grace. Through the mist, the arena on the crankshaft deck; behind sealed bars, the soul reliquary. Optional: the piston gallery and the ossuary under the engine. Shortcuts: the piston lift, the bone chute, the furnace's one-way door.
guide.brasshaven.soul_engine.title: The Soul Engine
guide.brasshaven.soul_stoker.p0: On the crankshaft deck under the crankcase roof of the Soul Engine, past the piston shaft, the site of grace and the mist, the Soul Stoker waits (620 health, armour 14): a hulking furnace-man four blocks tall, a blackstone boiler for a torso with a grated firebox burning blue soul fire, a skull-faced furnace door for a helmet, chimneys venting blue flame on his back, a giant coal shovel for one arm and a piston fist for the other.
guide.brasshaven.soul_stoker.p1: His shovel sweeps in front of him and flings embers that land on rings marked as they fly. He cocks his piston fist for a long breath while a line follows you, then punches a shockwave down it: step aside. He stokes his firebox with three shovelfuls of souls, a gauge climbing over his head, and vents a cone of blue flame. Rammed into the deck, his shovel cracks open soul-fire vents marked in rings, one under you.
guide.brasshaven.soul_stoker.title: The Soul Stoker
guide.brasshaven.soul_stoker_overpressur: At 65% he roars and grows faster: he charges down a lane drawn to you, opens his firebox for wither skeletons, flings more embers and opens more vents. At 30% his safety valves blow (jump the wave) and the deck takes up the engine's crank rhythm: strips across the deck burn in turn every three seconds, each pulse drawn two seconds ahead, so keep hopping to a safe strip. Every eleven seconds three rings of blue flame roll out of him, each with a gap drawn first that turns a little each ring; the rhythm stops while they roll.

His Remembrance, four Ancient Embers and two diamonds forge the Soul-Fire Shovel of the Stoker, whose right-click flings a fan of five soul embers along your aim: each bursts on the first foe or where it lands, and a foe caught by several bursts is hurt the more and set ablaze.
guide.brasshaven.spore_alchemist.p0: On top of the Spore Refinery's giant fly agaric, past the mist at the head of the ramp, the alchemist who refined its spores waits (620 health, armour 11), half-consumed by them: hunched under a fly agaric that grows out of his back, a brass respirator with glowing green lenses, a spore-tank feeding the nozzle-gun in his left hand and a flask-tipped stirring staff in his right.
guide.brasshaven.spore_alchemist.p1: His staff sweeps, then its flask comes down on a red ring. His nozzle-gun sprays a drawn cone of spores and leaves a lingering poison cloud. He lobs flasks onto rings coloured by their brew (green poison, grey slowness, black blindness), and rings open under your feet where mushrooms burst out a moment later and stand as obstacles for six seconds.
guide.brasshaven.spore_alchemist.title: The Spore Alchemist
guide.brasshaven.spore_alchemist_bloom.p: At 65% he roars and quickens: he vanishes into a spore cloud and bursts out of a marked ring near you, and stirs bogged up out of the mycelium. At 30% his hump blooms (jump the wave) and the cap breathes: vents near the edge burst on marked rings, mycelium threads slow you while you stay close to him, and every sixteen seconds the gilded ring flares while one side of it fills with spores: cross the ring before the cap breathes out.

His Remembrance, four map fragments and two diamonds forge the Stirring Staff of the Spore Alchemist, whose right-click flings a spore flask along your aim: it poisons the foes round where it shatters, then mycelium threads tether them there for three seconds before the spores burst again.
guide.brasshaven.spore_refinery.p0: An alchemists' spore works grown into three colossal mushrooms, 180 blocks across: a 90-high fly agaric with a 68-wide cap, a flat brown mushroom and a small red one, their stems hollowed into stair towers and wrapped in brass pipes and spore vats. Where: mushroom fields, else old-growth taigas.
guide.brasshaven.spore_refinery.p1: From the gatherers' camp (waystone) to the press yard (waystone): the screw-press hall, the fermentation hall, up the brown stem to the drying lofts (waystone), the rope bridge, then up the great stem to the gills chamber (waystone) and the arena on top of the cap. Optional: distillery, alchemists' lab, spore cellars. The cap lift, the spore chute and the cellars' one-way door lead back.
guide.brasshaven.spore_refinery.title: The Spore Refinery
guide.brasshaven.star_curator.p0: In the crater chamber under the Starfall Library, past the corkscrew down the meteorite, the grace and the mist, the keeper of the archive waits (780 health, armour 14): a tall robed scholar in indigo and brass whose head is the meteorite that wrecked his library, cracked open on a starfield. Five books orbit him and he fights with an astrolabe staff.
guide.brasshaven.star_curator.p1: His staff sweeps twice in front of him. His books fly after you, slowly: an arrow or a blow shoots each one down. When he plants the staff, gravity pulls you toward him for a second and a half before it implodes: sprint outward. Star-shards fall on circles that follow you, then lock: step out. Hug him and the books spin out; run and he streaks through you along a line.
guide.brasshaven.star_curator.title: The Star-Eater Curator
guide.brasshaven.star_curator_gravity.p0: At 65% he tears his books open: for seven seconds a storm of pages blinds and cuts whoever is outside the golden circles wheeling round the crater, and he keeps fighting meanwhile. He also draws constellations on the floor whose lines burst star by star. At 30% the crater's gravity inverts: every eight seconds a pulse lifts everyone who is not standing in a golden ring round a crystal brazier (never the one he stands at), and you float back down slowly; every ten seconds he blinks to a brazier and fires a star-lance across the crater that hits floating players too.
guide.brasshaven.star_curator_gravity.p1: His Remembrance, four Void Shards and two diamonds forge the Astrolabe of the Star-Eater Curator, whose right-click inverts gravity where you aim: the foes there are drawn together and float up, helpless and glowing.
guide.brasshaven.star_mote.p0: A spark of starlight with a crystal body, called down by a Star Mote Swarm-Caller. Tiny, quick and frail, it circles you, pulls back and spins up while its point flares, then darts straight at you. It fades away after a minute. Found in the Starfall Library.
guide.brasshaven.star_mote.title: Star Mote
guide.brasshaven.star_mote_caller.p0: A floating spindle of star crystal girdled with a brass astrolabe band, four little shards circling it. It keeps its distance. Its shards swing round in front of it while a thin trace of starlight shows where it aims; the trace thickens when the aim locks, and a short beam follows: step off the line. Once, it flings its shards out wide and swells and flares for a second before two star motes fall out of the dark; hit it during the flare to break the call. Come too close and it draws in tight before a nova throws you back. Found in the Starfall Library.
guide.brasshaven.star_mote_caller.title: Star Mote Swarm-Caller
guide.brasshaven.starfall_library.p0: A floating archive 170 blocks across among the outer End islands: a purpur-and-brass spindle tower 125 high under an astrolabe dome, three ring galleries hung round it on chain-and-rod spokes, and a fallen meteorite wedged in its side. Where: outer End islands.
guide.brasshaven.starfall_library.p1: From the islet, cross to the great door: map room, bookshelf canyons (waystone), the wall stair to the scriptorium, the upper hall (waystone) and the lens observatory. Ramp down to the galleries, cross the broken one on floating books (a basin catches falls), corkscrew down the meteorite to the grace and the crater arena. Behind sealed bars, the forbidden stacks; their pneumatic tube is the shortcut back.
guide.brasshaven.starfall_library.title: The Starfall Library
guide.brasshaven.steam_blocks.p0: Brass, copper and dark iron plating, clockwork and gauge panels, pipe bundles, Edison lamps, aether conduits, mahogany panelling, tufted leather and smokestack bricks. Most plates also come as stairs and slabs.
guide.brasshaven.steam_blocks.p1: Tip: keep brass for the trims and let dark iron and mahogany carry the mass; light it with Edison lamps. The Engraver's Chisel unlocks more variants.
guide.brasshaven.steam_blocks.title: Steampunk blocks
guide.brasshaven.steam_drone.p0: Hostile flying drones: at night over the steampunk lands, and in the Undercity. They circle and fire hot rivets.
guide.brasshaven.steam_drone.p1: When one rears up, it is about to dive at you: step aside. A bow brings them down. They drop brass nuggets, copper and sometimes a brass gear.
guide.brasshaven.steam_drone.title: Steam Drone
guide.brasshaven.storage_buttons.p0: Every chest, barrel or backpack shows small brass buttons above it: Sort, Take everything, Deposit the items it already holds, and Quick-stack into the chests around you.
guide.brasshaven.storage_buttons.p1: Type in the search box to light up the matching slots. Middle-click any slot to sort its inventory.
guide.brasshaven.storage_buttons.title: Storage buttons
guide.brasshaven.storage_relay.p0: A small brass beacon that stretches a Guild Terminal's reach: every chest up to 32 blocks around the relay joins the terminal's network. One terminal can then reach the whole base, even several buildings.
guide.brasshaven.storage_relay.p1: Craft (makes two): an ender pearl, four brass ingots, a redstone and a copper ingot.
guide.brasshaven.storage_relay.p2: Place it within 48 blocks of the terminal, or within 32 blocks of another linked relay: relays chain, so you can reach a far storage hall step by step. Right-click a relay to check that it is linked.
guide.brasshaven.storage_relay.title: Storage Relay
guide.brasshaven.storm_ascetic.p0: In the bell temple on the summit of Pilgrim's Ascent, the hermit waits under the great bell (580 health, armour 12): a gaunt old monk with a staff taller than himself, a straw hat on his back and nine prayer beads circling him. The storm answers him.
guide.brasshaven.storm_ascetic.p1: His staff reaches far: a sweep, then a thrust down a marked line. He vaults onto the ring that follows you (jump the wind), flings his beads out and back, calls lightning on the rings under your feet and whirls the staff if you hug him. His gust pushes you toward the walls, but never past the ring of cloud it draws.
guide.brasshaven.storm_ascetic.title: The Storm Ascetic
guide.brasshaven.storm_ascetic_bell.p0: At 65% he splits into three: two mirror images that die to any blow, the real one among them. He strikes three times (the last blow calls lightning down a line) and draws you in before a ring of wind. At 30% he kneels and the great bell answers: from then on it tolls by itself every eight seconds, a ring of thunder you must jump, and he rings it three times in a row.
guide.brasshaven.storm_ascetic_bell.p1: His Remembrance, four Map Fragments and two diamonds forge the Staff of the Storm Ascetic, whose right-click hurls foes away with a gust and calls lightning on the three nearest.
guide.brasshaven.strangler_queen.p0: On the summit terrace of the Canopy Temple-City, through the mist under the broken brass sun-disc, the fig that strangled the temple has crowned itself (620 health, armour 12): a towering woman of woven roots and jade, an orchid crown, a jade mask with golden eyes, a thorned root-whip for a left arm and a jade macuahuitl in her right hand.
guide.brasshaven.strangler_queen.p1: Her whip lashes 11 blocks down a green line and drags you in; her macuahuitl cuts twice in front of her. Roots burst from the floor in lines (stand between them) and in rings that roll outward (jump them). Her pollen clouds slow you more and more, then blind you: leave them. She swings on a vine to whoever runs away, and thorns burst round her if you hug her. Near the terrace edge her blows never throw you over.
guide.brasshaven.strangler_queen.title: The Strangler Fig Queen
At 65% she climbs into the sun-disc where you cannot reach her: jaguar spirits drop to hunt you (more in a larger party) and seed-bombs fall on marked players, so step out of the circles. Kill every spirit and she falls early, exposed. She plunges onto a circle that follows her target and then locks. At 30% she blooms once, then every 12 s root cages snap shut round marked players: get out of the circle before it closes, or break the roots from inside before she comes to harvest the cage.

Her Remembrance, four Map Fragments and two diamonds forge the Jade Macuahuitl of the Strangler Queen, whose right-click cracks a root lash along your aim: the first foe it meets is caged where it stands and the cage's thorns whip the foes beside it.
guide.brasshaven.sun_scarab.p0: A dog-sized sacred beetle of the Sun-Engine Ziggurat, its wing-cases inlaid with gold and lapis, a sun disc raised on its golden shield. On sand or sandstone it digs in nose first and vanishes; a furrow of churning sand runs toward you, and when the sand boils and rumbles under your feet, step off: it bursts out and throws you into the air. It cannot be hurt under the sand. Up close its head rears back and its mandibles spread before it bites; in daylight under the open sky its sun disc flares and the bite sets you on fire. Found in the Sun-Engine Ziggurat.
guide.brasshaven.sun_scarab.title: Sun Scarab
guide.brasshaven.sun_ziggurat.p0: A seven-stepped sandstone pyramid 140 blocks wide, crowned by a colossal brass orrery whose amber sun-lens focuses daylight down a shaft through the core. Where: open desert.
guide.brasshaven.sun_ziggurat.p1: From the waystone camp, an avenue of sphinxes leads to the processional ramp and the pylon gate. The hypostyle hall of 25 columns is a site of grace; the sand-flooded lower halls lie below. Climb through the astronomer-priests' quarter and the terraces to the lens-calibration chamber, pass the sealed tomb gallery, and descend the annex to the antechamber (site of grace). Through the mist, the sun chamber under the lens is the arena; behind sealed bars, the vault and a lift down the core back to the halls.
guide.brasshaven.sun_ziggurat.title: Sun-Engine Ziggurat
guide.brasshaven.sylvan.p0: Tall, slender and long-eared, the sylvans tend the Sylvan Palace and the Hollow Giant Tree. Gardeners kneel at their flower beds, herbalists brew healing potions, woodwrights carve glowwood: each sells the fruit of its craft. Wardens with longbows watch over them.
guide.brasshaven.sylvan.p2: They sell, among other things: gardener: glowwood saplings, flowers, glow berries; herbalist: healing potions, golden carrots; woodwright: glowwood, arrows, bows.
guide.brasshaven.sylvan.title: Sylvans
guide.brasshaven.sylvan_palace.p0: An elven palace grown around a colossal silver tree 70 blocks tall. A spiral stair climbs around the trunk to three terraces and their pavilions.
guide.brasshaven.sylvan_palace.p1: Where: dark forests, old-growth taigas, old-growth birch forests and flower forests.
guide.brasshaven.sylvan_palace.p2: Inside the trunk: the throne hall and the royal treasury. Up in the leaves: the library and, at the very top, the Moon Lantern. Rope bridges lead to three tree houses. The sylvan court lives in the pavilions: a healer, librarians, a weaver, a cook, a gardener and the royal cartographer.
guide.brasshaven.sylvan_palace.title: Sylvan Palace
guide.brasshaven.symmetry.p0: Build in mirror: every block the wand places is copied on the other side of a plane.
guide.brasshaven.symmetry.p1: 1. Sneak-right-click a block with the wand: it becomes the mirror centre (sparks show the plane) and mirror X turns on.
guide.brasshaven.symmetry.p2: 2. Press G (or sneak-click the centre again) to switch: off, mirror X (east/west), mirror Z (north/south), mirror X + Z (4 ways).
guide.brasshaven.symmetry.p3: 3. Build as usual: gold outlines are your blocks, blue ones their mirrored copies (stairs turn the right way). Each copy costs a block; undo removes them all.
guide.brasshaven.symmetry.title: Wand symmetry
guide.brasshaven.talents.p0: Press K to open your talent tree: four branches, Warrior, Explorer, Arcanist and Engineer. Each talent costs points and needs one of the talents linked above it.
guide.brasshaven.talents.p1: Points: 1 per quest (3 for a boss quest) and 1 every 10 experience levels gained.
guide.brasshaven.talents.p2: The last talent of each branch is an active power: once unlocked, click it to equip it, then press V to use it.
guide.brasshaven.talents.p3: Changed your mind? Drink a Vial of Oblivion to get every point back (glass bottle, ghast tear and amethyst shard).
guide.brasshaven.talents.title: Talent tree
guide.brasshaven.terminal_network.p0: Items go first into a chest that already holds the same item, then into sorting chests, then into any free slot. Search by name (@name: by mod); the sort button cycles count, name and mod.
guide.brasshaven.terminal_network.p1: The chest-network button (top right) lists the linked containers by type. Click one to exclude it, like a trash chest or a furnace input chest; click again to link it back. "Show in world" outlines them all for 10 seconds: gold linked, red excluded.
guide.brasshaven.terminal_network.title: Terminal: network & sorting
guide.brasshaven.terrain_touches.p0: The vanilla biomes get a few natural touches: mossy boulders in plains, meadows, forests and taigas, fallen logs in dark forests, savannas and cherry groves, wildflower patches, moss carpets under old trees, small rock spires on stony peaks and windswept hills, and hot-spring terraces in the savanna highlands.
guide.brasshaven.terrain_touches.p1: Each can be switched off on a server (options world.terrain.*); new chunks only.
guide.brasshaven.terrain_touches.title: Wilder landscapes
guide.brasshaven.tesla_observatory.p0: A science campus on a rocky crag: a copper dome with a 30-block telescope, a 70-block Tesla tower and an orrery under a glass dome.
guide.brasshaven.tesla_observatory.p1: Where: on mountain tops and windswept hills.
guide.brasshaven.tesla_observatory.p2: Between the buildings: the library, the laboratory and the star-chart hall. Bring blocks to climb the crag.
guide.brasshaven.tesla_observatory.title: Tesla Observatory
guide.brasshaven.thorn_gardener.p0: On the giant lily pad in the pool of the Sunken Arboretum's palm house, under the hanging sun-lamp, past the mist of the cornice door, the last gardener still tends the garden (650 health, armour 12): a tall brass automaton overgrown with moss and ivy, a glass bell jar for a head with a glowing flower inside, long arms ending in pruning shears and a watering can made into a cannon on his back.
guide.brasshaven.thorn_gardener.p1: His shears snip twice (the second arc drawn red first) and lunge down a drawn lane. Thorns burst along marked lines, a vine snare closes on a marked ring and roots you for a moment (hit anything to tear it), and his watering cannon sprays a drawn cone that pushes a little and fertilizes patches where thorn bushes spring up for five seconds. Near the rim his blows never throw you into the water.
guide.brasshaven.thorn_gardener.title: The Head Gardener
guide.brasshaven.thorn_gardener_sun.p0: At 65% he roars and quickens: he clacks his shears to call dart frogs and clockwork spiders, and shakes pollen onto marked rings. At 30% the sun-lamp ignites (jump the wave): sunbeams sweep the pad along drawn paths, and every sixteen seconds he basks in a ring of light to heal; step into the ring to shade him and he gains nothing, while he stands still for your blows.
guide.brasshaven.thorn_gardener_sun.p1: His Remembrance, four map fragments and two diamonds forge the Pruning Shears of the Head Gardener, whose right-click snaps the blades shut along your aim: every foe between them is cut (more if under half health), thorns snare round each one, and every cut heals you a little.
guide.brasshaven.tidal_abbey.p0: A rocky tidal island off the shore: ring walls with seven towers and a sea gate, a town of stone houses with slate roofs spiralling up the rock, and on the summit a gothic abbey whose spire tops out at 130 blocks. A stone causeway leads there, half drowned and broken in the middle.
guide.brasshaven.tidal_abbey.p1: Where: beaches and stony shores, with the sea on one side.
guide.brasshaven.tidal_abbey.p2: Follow the Grande Rue from the King's Gate (waystone in the court) past the well square and the parish church to the Chatelet and the Grand Degre. Up top: the nave, the treasury behind the altar, the cloister (look down the well), the knights' hall. The stair tower goes down to the crypt and its site of grace; beyond is the tidal hall, the arena, then the vault and a tunnel out to the harbour.
guide.brasshaven.tidal_abbey.title: Tidal Abbey
guide.brasshaven.tide_abbess.p0: Down the narrow stair under the Tidal Abbey's church, in the rotunda lit by shafts of sea light, the drowned abbess waits (560 health, armour 12): a tall saint in a barnacled chasuble and a veil crowned with coral, a nautilus crozier in her right hand and a bell-censer swinging from her left.
guide.brasshaven.tide_abbess.p1: She sweeps with the crozier, swings the censer (its brine smoke lingers: leave it), glides down a line of bubbles, tolls the bell to draw everyone in before the brine bursts round her (run against the pull), and strikes the floor to send a wall of water across the whole rotunda: it is too tall to jump, so stand in one of the gaps marked in sea glass. Her drowned acolytes rise every half minute.
guide.brasshaven.tide_abbess.title: The Abbess of the Tides
guide.brasshaven.tide_abbess_flood.p0: At 65% a second wave crosses the first, geysers burst under every player and she swings the censer twice. At 30% she kneels and floods the rotunda: you wade, she swims, and every 12 s she dives into the riptide and swims through three marks. The water drains when she falls.
guide.brasshaven.tide_abbess_flood.p1: Her Remembrance, four Map Fragments and two diamonds forge the Crozier of the Drowned Abbess, whose right-click sends a breaking wave ahead that sweeps foes along.
guide.brasshaven.tide_abbess_flood.title: Abbess: the Flood
guide.brasshaven.tide_wraith.p0: A drowned sailor's ghost floating over the flooded abbey, a gaff and chain round its wrist. It glides through water as easily as air, and while it is in water arrows and blows pass through it: fight it on dry stone. It rakes with its claws; it spreads both arms and gapes before lunging to hook you, then drags you toward the nearest water (hit it to break free). It can sink into water and rise again right behind you. Found in the Tidal Abbey.
guide.brasshaven.tide_wraith.title: Tide Wraith
guide.brasshaven.titan_forge.p0: A forge 217 blocks across over a Nether lava lake, built into a kneeling basalt-and-brass titan 85 high, its hammer raised over a giant anvil. Where: basalt deltas, crimson forests.
guide.brasshaven.titan_forge.p1: From the outpost (waystone), cross the causeway to the plinth: casting hall, giant bellows, grand stair to the crucible terrace (waystone). Up the titan from its knee: barracks, armoury, smelting hall, then the left arm to the winch room (waystone) and the crane-bridge into the hand. Through the mist, the arena on the anvil; behind sealed bars, the vault. The spine lift is the shortcut back.
guide.brasshaven.titan_forge.title: Forge of the Basalt Titan
guide.brasshaven.tools.p0: The Excavator Pickaxe mines 3x3 and the Lumber Axe fells whole trees. Sneak to break a single block.
guide.brasshaven.tools.p1: Craft each with three Lithite shards and two sticks, shaped like a pickaxe or an axe.
guide.brasshaven.tools.title: Special tools
guide.brasshaven.trade.p0: Open a player's card (sneak + right-click them) and click Trade. When they accept, a trade screen opens for both: put what you give in your 9 slots, watch their offer on the right.
guide.brasshaven.trade.p1: When both press Accept, a 3-second countdown starts. Any change to either offer cancels both acceptances, so nobody can swap an item at the last moment. At zero the items change hands at once.
guide.brasshaven.trade.p2: Stay within 8 blocks. Walking away, closing the screen or logging out gives each offer back to its owner; what no longer fits goes to your Pneumatic Post inbox, never on the ground.
guide.brasshaven.trade.title: Secure trade
guide.brasshaven.turbine_automaton.p0: A barrel-chested maintenance machine of the drowned dam, green with verdigris, a rotor turning in its chest. When it crouches and its rotor spins faster and faster while steam screams from its stacks, it is about to dash in a straight line: step out of the way and it skids past. Up close it raises both paddle hands over its head before slamming them down, and sinks onto its haunches with arms thrown wide before venting a scalding cloud around it. When it breaks, its boiler bursts: do not stand next to it. Found in the Dam of the Drowned Valley.
guide.brasshaven.turbine_automaton.title: Turbine Automaton
guide.brasshaven.turbine_tyrant.p0: Past Generator Hall II at the foot of the Dam of the Drowned Valley, in the main turbine chamber, the dam's engineer waits (600 health, armour 14), fused into his turbine: a walking scroll-case on hydraulic legs, a turbine rotor for a right arm and a valve-wrench as long as a man in his left fist.
guide.brasshaven.turbine_tyrant.p1: Hear the rotor whine before it sweeps; step off the line his wrench marks, the crack runs on and blows any grate it crosses. When he cranks his valve, get off the hissing copper grates. When he swells and the gauges climb, break his line of sight: a pillar or a generator in its alcove, or simply get out of range. Only those he can see take the blast.
guide.brasshaven.turbine_tyrant.title: The Turbine Tyrant
guide.brasshaven.turbine_tyrant_overload: At 65% he combos rotor, wrench and rotor, draws everyone in with his spinning rotor before he whirls, blows the grates one after another round the chamber, and his blast reaches 19 blocks. At 30% he kneels and overloads: faster, the grates blow on their own, and every 11 s he dashes across the chamber through three marks, leaving sparks that burn.
His Remembrance, four Map Fragments and two diamonds forge the Valve-Wrench of the Turbine Tyrant, whose right-click vents a blast of steam at every foe you can see around you.
guide.brasshaven.undercity.p0: A town on stilts clinging to the walls of a vast cavern, around a central pillar and a toxic green lake, joined by catwalks and lit by lamps.
guide.brasshaven.undercity.p1: Where: under any biome, deep down: its lake lies around y -15.
guide.brasshaven.undercity.p2: A family lives in every stilt house and no monster spawns in the cavern. Climb the pillar's ladders to reach the upper levels and the vault.
guide.brasshaven.undercity.title: The Undercity
guide.brasshaven.verdant_arboretum.p0: A botanical research complex in a vast lush cavern 40-60 blocks down, 185 blocks long: a brass-and-glass palm house whose 50-high dome holds up the cavern roof on its ribs, a waterfall-fed lily lake with dripleaf islands, terraced greenhouses, aqueducts and a sun-lamp hung from the roof. Where: lush caves.
guide.brasshaven.verdant_arboretum.p1: From the botanists' camp in a side tunnel (waystone) to the lake shore station (waystone): greenhouses, seed vault, specimen lab, pump house, azalea maze; up the rib catwalks to the dome cornice (waystone) and the arena on the lily-pad island. The dripleaf drop, the pump-house water lift and the greenhouse's one-way door lead back.
guide.brasshaven.verdant_arboretum.title: The Sunken Arboretum
guide.brasshaven.villages.p0: Every kind of village (plains, desert, savanna, snow, taiga) grows new buildings in its own style: an inn with rooms, a tinkerer's workshop, a watchtower, a market, an orchard, cottages, manors and wells.
guide.brasshaven.villages.p1: About one village in four is built around a square with a waystone: right-click it to put the village on the travel map. The notice board and the meeting bell stand beside it.
guide.brasshaven.villages.p2: Quest givers live there too: a Guild Agent in the Guild Post and by the square's notice board, a Scholar in the inn's tavern, a Tinkerer in the workshop. Right-click them for contracts.
guide.brasshaven.villages.p3: Streets get brass lamps, signposts and planters. Pillager outposts now field steam ballistas and spiked barricades.
guide.brasshaven.villages.title: Villages
guide.brasshaven.void_acolyte.p0: A masked cultist of the Shattered Halo, a broken halo floating behind its head. It draws an orb of void light to its chest and lets it swell, then throws it: the orb drifts after you and lifts you off the ground; dodge it or break the line with a block. It blinks a few blocks away to flank you: the spot it will land on flickers first. Corner it and it stabs with its dagger. Found on the Shattered Halo.
guide.brasshaven.void_acolyte.title: Void Acolyte
guide.brasshaven.volcanic_highlands.p0: Ochre mountains banded with terracotta under an ashen sky. Black rock and glowing magma break through the tan grass, lava pools steam in the hollows and lava trickles down the slopes. Smoke rises from vents, and a few Rustwoods cling to the ground. Watch your step.
guide.brasshaven.volcanic_highlands.p1: Where: half of the mountain ranges of the badlands.
guide.brasshaven.walking_fortress.p0: The wreck of a brass siege walker frozen mid-stride in a scorched crater: four 60-block legs, a riveted hull carried 55 blocks up, smokestacks and a mast reaching y 130.
guide.brasshaven.walking_fortress.p1: Where: badlands, savannas, plains and deserts.
guide.brasshaven.walking_fortress.p2: The way in is a breach in a planted foot: climb the spiral inside the leg, cross the knee, take the stair up the thigh into the hold. The boss waits on the top deck; the vault is in the bridge tower.
guide.brasshaven.walking_fortress.title: Walking Fortress
guide.brasshaven.wand.p0: It lays whole rows of blocks at once. Hold it and look at a block: gold outlines show where the copies will go. Right-click to extend that face with blocks of the same kind from your inventory (16 at a time, 64 with the Master wand).
guide.brasshaven.wand.p1: Made a mistake? Sneak-right-click in the air to undo the last use: the blocks come back to you.
guide.brasshaven.wand.p2: Craft, in a column: an amethyst shard, a gold ingot, a stick. Master wand: the wand between two Lithite shards, a diamond above it.
guide.brasshaven.wand.title: Builder's Wand
guide.brasshaven.watch.p0: Its hand follows the sun, and a little window shows the sun by day and the moon by night.
guide.brasshaven.watch.p1: Right-click: time, day number, moon phase and the biome you stand in.
guide.brasshaven.watch.p2: Craft: a brass nugget, three brass ingots and a redstone.
guide.brasshaven.watch.title: Pocket Watch
guide.brasshaven.waystones.p0: Waystones link the world. Right-click one to discover it for the whole group and open the travel map.
guide.brasshaven.waystones.p1: In the map, click a destination then Travel (or double-click it). Pin your favourites with the star and rename them.
guide.brasshaven.waystones.p2: Craft your own for your base, your farms or a dungeon entrance: an ender pearl, two Map Fragments, a compass and three stone bricks.
guide.brasshaven.waystones.title: Waystones
guide.brasshaven.welcome.p0: This world hides dozens of hand-built structures, dungeons, bosses and giant wonders. Your group explores it together: quests, waystones and discoveries are shared by everyone.
guide.brasshaven.welcome.p1: To begin, follow the card at the top-right: it always shows your next step. First, meet a Guild Agent: the nearest Guild Outpost is marked on your map (M). The rest is earned: see "The road ahead".
guide.brasshaven.welcome.p2: This manual explains every system. Click a page in the contents on the left; turn pages with the arrows, the mouse wheel or the arrow keys. When a page goes on, the button reads "More >".
guide.brasshaven.welcome.p3: Shortcut: hover a Brasshaven item in your inventory and hold the manual key (W, or the key its tooltip shows; Controls to change it) to open its page. Lost the manual? Craft a book and a feather.
guide.brasshaven.welcome.title: Welcome, Wayfarer
guide.brasshaven.wonders.p0: Wonders are giant places, far bigger than other structures: towns, palaces, a volcano, caverns, islands in the sky... Each one has its page in this chapter, and finding it completes a quest.
guide.brasshaven.wonders.p1: The ten wonders: Clockwork Citadel, Sky Harbour, The Undercity, Deep Dwarven City, Sylvan Palace, Inventor's Manor, Sky Isles, Geothermal Foundry, Tesla Observatory and Crystal Cathedral.
guide.brasshaven.wonders.p2: They are rare, often one or two thousand blocks apart. Sneak-right-click the Structure Compass until it names the one you want (wonders are at the end of the list), then right-click it for the distance and direction.
guide.brasshaven.wonders.p3: Underground wonders lie under any biome: dig down to the depth given on their page.
guide.brasshaven.wonders.p4: Most barrels hold a few supplies that fit the room; the real loot stays in the chests.
guide.brasshaven.wonders.title: How to find them
guide.brasshaven.world_stones.p0: Three stones, found in big veins like granite: marble in the mountains (from y 32 up), rust rock in the badlands and the savanna highlands, blue slate deep down in the deepslate (below y 0).
guide.brasshaven.world_stones.p1: Polished, bricks, pillar, tiles, stairs, slabs and walls come from the stonecutter, and the Engraver's Chisel switches between them.
guide.brasshaven.world_stones.p2: Or craft them: two calcite and two diorite make 4 marble; four granite around an iron nugget, 4 rust rock; four cobbled deepslate around a lapis lazuli, 4 blue slate.
guide.brasshaven.world_stones.title: Marble, rust rock, blue slate
guide.brasshaven.world_woods.p0: Two woods to grow yourself. Glowwood: pale trunks under teal leaves that glow at night. Rustwood: dark red bark and rust-orange leaves on forked trees.
guide.brasshaven.world_woods.p1: Craft a sapling: an oak sapling, glow berries and glowstone dust (Glowwood); an acacia sapling and raw iron (Rustwood). Elven and forest ruins hide Glowwood saplings in their chests, steampunk workshops Rustwood ones.
guide.brasshaven.world_woods.p2: Each gives a full set like oak: logs, bark, planks, stairs, slabs, fences, gates, doors, trapdoors, buttons and pressure plates. An axe strips the logs; the leaves drop saplings that grow the same tree.
guide.brasshaven.world_woods.title: Glowwood and Rustwood
guide.brasshaven.wrench.p0: Right-click a block to turn it: stairs, logs, chests, hoppers, signs, machines, furniture. Sneak: the other way. Doors, beds and double chests stay put.
guide.brasshaven.wrench.p1: Sneak-right-click: a Brasshaven machine changes its setting; Brasshaven decoration or furniture comes back to your inventory.
guide.brasshaven.wrench.p2: Craft: three brass ingots and an iron ingot.
guide.brasshaven.wrench.title: Brass Wrench
item.brasshaven.abbess_crozier.desc: Use: strike the crozier down; a breaking wave rolls ahead and sweeps every foe in it along, and the sea carries you (Dolphin's Grace, 6 s).
item.brasshaven.abbess_crozier.flavor: She led her flock into the sea; the sea still follows her staff.
item.brasshaven.abbot_dragonstaff: Dragon Staff of the Chime Abbot
item.brasshaven.abbot_dragonstaff.desc: Use: strike the staff and the brass dragon's spirit rushes along your aim (up to 14 blocks, stopped by walls); every foe it passes is hurt, flung aside out of its lane and blinded by petals, and the chimes in its jaws ring where it ends, slowing every foe within 3 blocks.
item.brasshaven.abbot_dragonstaff.flavor: He rang the chimes for nine hundred years; the brass dragon still wakes when they sound.
item.brasshaven.admiral_cutlass: Boarding Cutlass of the Drowned Admiral
item.brasshaven.admiral_cutlass.desc: Use: fire the deck cannon along your aim; the shell bursts on the first foe or wall it meets (up to 24 blocks): full damage within 1 block of the burst, half at 3.5, foes hurled away and set ablaze; the recoil kicks you a step back.
item.brasshaven.admiral_cutlass.flavor: He went down with his ship and kept the cannon loaded.
item.brasshaven.aether_boots.desc: Set: +75 max mana, mana regenerates twice as fast, no fall damage.
item.brasshaven.aether_boots.flavor: Crystal plates that drift a hair above the skin.
item.brasshaven.aether_chestplate.desc: Set: +75 max mana, mana regenerates twice as fast, no fall damage.
item.brasshaven.aether_chestplate.flavor: Crystal plates that drift a hair above the skin.
item.brasshaven.aether_helmet.desc: Set: +75 max mana, mana regenerates twice as fast, no fall damage.
item.brasshaven.aether_helmet.flavor: Crystal plates that drift a hair above the skin.
item.brasshaven.aether_leggings.desc: Set: +75 max mana, mana regenerates twice as fast, no fall damage.
item.brasshaven.aether_leggings.flavor: Crystal plates that drift a hair above the skin.
item.brasshaven.airship_compass.desc: Use: find the nearest Sky Harbour.
item.brasshaven.airship_compass.desc2: In the End: the Void Ship Wreck.
item.brasshaven.airship_compass.desc3: Its needle then keeps pointing there.
item.brasshaven.airship_compass.flavor: Its needle dreams of mooring masts.
item.brasshaven.alchemist_staff: Stirring Staff of the Spore Alchemist
item.brasshaven.alchemist_staff.desc: Use: fling a spore flask along your aim (up to 12 blocks, walls stop it); it shatters on the first foe it meets or where its flight ends, poisoning every foe within 2.5 blocks. Mycelium threads then tether every foe within 4 blocks to the spot for 3 s, dragging back and slowing those that stray, and when they snap the spores burst again for half the damage.
item.brasshaven.alchemist_staff.flavor: He stirred the vats until the spores stirred him back.
item.brasshaven.ancient_ember.desc: Still warm after a thousand years in the Nether.
item.brasshaven.arcane_boots.desc: Set: +100 max mana and spells 25% stronger.
item.brasshaven.arcane_boots.flavor: Embroidered with runes that rearrange themselves.
item.brasshaven.arcane_chestplate.desc: Set: +100 max mana and spells 25% stronger.
item.brasshaven.arcane_chestplate.flavor: Embroidered with runes that rearrange themselves.
item.brasshaven.arcane_helmet.desc: Set: +100 max mana and spells 25% stronger.
item.brasshaven.arcane_helmet.flavor: Embroidered with runes that rearrange themselves.
item.brasshaven.arcane_leggings.desc: Set: +100 max mana and spells 25% stronger.
item.brasshaven.arcane_leggings.flavor: Embroidered with runes that rearrange themselves.
item.brasshaven.arcane_ring.desc: Worn in a ring slot: +50 max mana.
item.brasshaven.arcane_ring.flavor: A band of violet light that hums against the skin.
item.brasshaven.architect_plumb.desc: Use: let the plumb-bob fall from on high onto the spot you aim at (up to 16 blocks); it crushes every foe within 2.5 blocks of it and pins them to the ground for 2 s.
item.brasshaven.architect_plumb.flavor: He built downward until the plumb line touched the abyss.
item.brasshaven.ascetic_staff.desc: Use: strike the staff on the ground; a gust hurls every foe around you away and lightning falls on the three nearest.
item.brasshaven.ascetic_staff.flavor: Its rings still ring with the storm he prayed to.
item.brasshaven.ash_greatsword.flavor: Ash falls from it like snow.
item.brasshaven.baron_drillpick.desc: Use: fling a bundle of lit dynamite along your aim (up to 14 blocks); it sticks to the first foe it meets or lies where it lands, its fuse burns 1.5 s, then it blows without breaking a block: every foe within 3.5 blocks is hurt (half at the edge), set ablaze and hurled away, and the foe it stuck to takes half again.
item.brasshaven.baron_drillpick.flavor: He bought the mountain, then blasted it open for the gold inside; he still owes the miners.
item.brasshaven.bastion_cannon.desc: Use: a blast that tears through everything ahead and hurls foes off their feet; the recoil throws you back a few steps.
item.brasshaven.bastion_cannon.flavor: The east bastion's gunners never ran out of powder, only of walls.
item.brasshaven.bell_hammer.desc: Use: toll a ring of sound that staggers foes.
item.brasshaven.boarding_axe.desc: Chops wood like an axe and knocks shields aside. Use: a boarding rush 6 blocks ahead, hacking every foe on the way (7 damage) and bracing you (Resistance I, 3 s).
item.brasshaven.boarding_axe.flavor: Standard issue for cutting rigging, doors and, when it came to it, the enemy.
item.brasshaven.bog_lantern_flail.desc: Your hits poison foes for 3 s. Use: the lantern flares, revealing every foe within 6 blocks (Glowing, 10 s) and choking them in marsh gas; you see in the dark for 30 s.
item.brasshaven.bog_lantern_flail.flavor: The marsh light that leads pilgrims astray, caught in a cage and swung back at the bog.
item.brasshaven.bog_pilgrim_boots.desc: One of the four pieces of the Bog Pilgrim's Wraps.
item.brasshaven.bog_pilgrim_boots.flavor: Waxed reed and gator hide: the bog takes everything but the pilgrim.
item.brasshaven.bog_pilgrim_chestplate.d: One of the four pieces of the Bog Pilgrim's Wraps.
item.brasshaven.bog_pilgrim_chestplate.f: Waxed reed and gator hide: the bog takes everything but the pilgrim.
item.brasshaven.bog_pilgrim_helmet.desc: One of the four pieces of the Bog Pilgrim's Wraps.
item.brasshaven.bog_pilgrim_helmet.flavo: Waxed reed and gator hide: the bog takes everything but the pilgrim.
item.brasshaven.bog_pilgrim_leggings.des: One of the four pieces of the Bog Pilgrim's Wraps.
item.brasshaven.bog_pilgrim_leggings.fla: Waxed reed and gator hide: the bog takes everything but the pilgrim.
item.brasshaven.brass_boots.desc: Set: night vision and +20% mining speed (brass goggles).
item.brasshaven.brass_boots.flavor: Polished by guild apprentices every morning.
item.brasshaven.brass_chestplate.desc: Set: night vision and +20% mining speed (brass goggles).
item.brasshaven.brass_chestplate.flavor: Polished by guild apprentices every morning.
item.brasshaven.brass_gear.desc: A precise little cog salvaged from an automaton.
item.brasshaven.brass_glider.desc: Worn on your back or held: opens when you fall. No fall damage.
item.brasshaven.brass_glider.desc2: You sink slowly and glide where you look.
item.brasshaven.brass_glider.desc3: Wears 1 durability every 2 seconds of flight.
item.brasshaven.brass_glider.flavor: Leather wings on a brass frame: the sky's own staircase.
item.brasshaven.brass_helmet.desc: Set: night vision and +20% mining speed (brass goggles).
item.brasshaven.brass_helmet.flavor: Polished by guild apprentices every morning.
item.brasshaven.brass_leggings.desc: Set: night vision and +20% mining speed (brass goggles).
item.brasshaven.brass_leggings.flavor: Polished by guild apprentices every morning.
item.brasshaven.brass_wrench.desc: Use on a block: turn it (stairs, logs, chests, machines...).
item.brasshaven.brass_wrench.desc2: Sneak-use on a Brasshaven machine: change its setting.
item.brasshaven.brass_wrench.desc3: Sneak-use on Brasshaven decoration or furniture: pick it up.
item.brasshaven.brass_wrench.flavor: Every guild engineer swears by it, and at it.
item.brasshaven.builder_wand.desc: Use on a block: extend that face by up to 16 blocks from your inventory. Sneak-use in the air: undo. Sneak-use a block: mirror centre; G: symmetry mode.
item.brasshaven.builder_wand.flavor: For walls that would take all day.
item.brasshaven.caldera_castellan_spawn_: The Castellan of the Caldera Spawn Egg
item.brasshaven.caldera_halberd.desc: Use: drive the halberd into the ground; a molten rift runs along it and forks, searing every foe on it.
item.brasshaven.caldera_halberd.flavor: Forged in the throat of a dead volcano.
item.brasshaven.canopy_stalker_boots.des: One of the four pieces of the Canopy Stalker's Leathers.
item.brasshaven.canopy_stalker_boots.fla: The temple's hunters never touched the ground between two kills.
item.brasshaven.canopy_stalker_chestplat: One of the four pieces of the Canopy Stalker's Leathers.
The temple's hunters never touched the ground between two kills.
item.brasshaven.canopy_stalker_helmet.de: One of the four pieces of the Canopy Stalker's Leathers.
item.brasshaven.canopy_stalker_helmet.fl: The temple's hunters never touched the ground between two kills.
One of the four pieces of the Canopy Stalker's Leathers.
