item.brasshaven.cantor_baton: Tuning-Fork Baton of the Hollow Cantor
item.brasshaven.cantor_baton.desc: Use: strike the fork and loose a shriek in a cone ahead (up to 12 blocks, walls stop it); every foe in it is hurt, thrown back and weakened, and where the shriek meets a wall its echo bursts for half the damage on the foes within 3 blocks of it.
item.brasshaven.cantor_baton.flavor: His choir fell silent long ago; he still beats time for it, and the cathedral still answers.
item.brasshaven.cartographer_blade.flavo: Engraved with the coastlines it has crossed.
item.brasshaven.chisel.desc: Use on a block: turn it into the next variant of its family (stone bricks, mossy, cracked, chiseled...). Sneak-use: previous variant. Stairs and slabs keep their shape.
item.brasshaven.chisel.flavor: Stone remembers every shape it could have had.
item.brasshaven.clockmaker_pendulum.desc: Use: a pendulum sweep that slows foes as if time stood still.
item.brasshaven.clockmaker_pendulum.flav: Tick. Tock. Your turn is over.
item.brasshaven.clockwork_heart.desc: Use it on two stacked Blocks of Brass to wake a Brass Golem that follows you.
item.brasshaven.clockwork_heart.flavor: It ticks in your palm, waiting for a body.
item.brasshaven.commodore_anchor: Ice Anchor of the Frozen Commodore
item.brasshaven.commodore_anchor.desc: Use: hurl the anchor along your aim on its chain (up to 12 blocks, walls stop it); it bites the first foe it meets or the end of its throw, then the chain drags it back to you: every foe it passes on the way back is hit again, hauled toward you and slowed, and where it bit the frost bursts round it.
item.brasshaven.commodore_anchor.flavor: He swore to bring the fleet home through the ice; the rig still keeps him to his word.
item.brasshaven.corsair_harpoon: Harpoon Gun of the Corsair Captain
item.brasshaven.corsair_harpoon.desc: Use: fire a harpoon along your aim (up to 18 blocks). If it bites a foe, the line reels you to it and you cut it as you land (it is hurt and slowed); if it bites a wall, it hauls you there. The rotor always lets you down softly (Slow Falling 3 s).
item.brasshaven.corsair_harpoon.flavor: She boarded the last airship of the fleet with it and never set foot on the ground again.
item.brasshaven.crone_ladle.desc: Use: splash a lingering poison brew where you look.
item.brasshaven.crystal_fang.desc: Use: crystal spikes burst along a line.
item.brasshaven.crystal_fang.flavor: A spider's fang grown into a crystal blade.
item.brasshaven.curator_astrolabe.desc: Use: turn the astrolabe and invert gravity at the spot you aim at (up to 16 blocks); every foe within 4 blocks of it is hurt, drawn to its heart and hurled upward, floating helpless for 1.5 s (Levitation III) and glowing for 4 s before it falls back down.
item.brasshaven.curator_astrolabe.flavor: He catalogued the stars until one fell on him; now he keeps it for a head.
item.brasshaven.director_bonesaw.desc: Use: the saw rips you forward along your aim (up to 8 blocks, walls stop you), cutting and slowing every foe you pass. The pocket watch on its handle remembers where you started: 2 s later it snaps you back there and the saw's echo cuts every foe within 2.5 blocks of the spot for half the damage. Sneak when it chimes to stay.
item.brasshaven.director_bonesaw.flavor: She never lost a patient; she simply wound the clock back and began again.
item.brasshaven.diving_helmet.desc: Head under water: Conduit Power (breathing, clear sight, full mining speed).
item.brasshaven.diving_helmet.flavor: Brass, glass and a serpent's scales.
item.brasshaven.dune_king_crook.desc: Use: a low beam of judgement lances ahead, burning foes and dragging their steps.
item.brasshaven.dune_king_crook.flavor: The dunes still bow to it.
item.brasshaven.ember_boots.desc: Set: fire immunity and faster in lava.
item.brasshaven.ember_boots.flavor: Still glowing from the Nether's forges.
item.brasshaven.ember_chestplate.desc: Set: fire immunity and faster in lava.
item.brasshaven.ember_chestplate.flavor: Still glowing from the Nether's forges.
item.brasshaven.ember_helmet.desc: Set: fire immunity and faster in lava.
item.brasshaven.ember_helmet.flavor: Still glowing from the Nether's forges.
item.brasshaven.ember_leggings.desc: Set: fire immunity and faster in lava.
item.brasshaven.ember_leggings.flavor: Still glowing from the Nether's forges.
item.brasshaven.ember_of_ascension.desc: Dropped by bosses from NG+ cycle 3. Anvil: boss weapon + this = +1 attack damage (max +5).
item.brasshaven.ember_scythe.desc: Sets foes ablaze. Heals you in the Nether.
item.brasshaven.ember_scythe.flavor: Forged in the Nether, homesick ever since.
item.brasshaven.ember_signet.desc: Worn: your melee hits set foes ablaze for 3 s.
item.brasshaven.ember_signet.flavor: Its seal still glows on every order it signed.
item.brasshaven.excavator_pickaxe.desc: Mines 3x3. Sneak to mine one block.
item.brasshaven.excavator_pickaxe.flavor: Why dig one block when you can dig nine?
item.brasshaven.explorer_backpack.desc: Use: 54 extra slots. Craft it from a Travel Backpack and a brass ingot: nothing inside is lost.
item.brasshaven.explorer_backpack.flavor: Twice the room, the same straps.
item.brasshaven.explorer_boots.desc: Set: Speed, no fall damage below 8 blocks, night vision underground.
item.brasshaven.explorer_boots.flavor: Worn soft by a hundred roads.
item.brasshaven.explorer_chestplate.desc: Set: Speed, no fall damage below 8 blocks, night vision underground.
item.brasshaven.explorer_chestplate.flav: Worn soft by a hundred roads.
item.brasshaven.explorer_helmet.desc: Set: Speed, no fall damage below 8 blocks, night vision underground.
item.brasshaven.explorer_helmet.flavor: Worn soft by a hundred roads.
item.brasshaven.explorer_leggings.desc: Set: Speed, no fall damage below 8 blocks, night vision underground.
item.brasshaven.explorer_leggings.flavor: Worn soft by a hundred roads.
item.brasshaven.fire_staff.desc: Spell (15 mana): a fire bolt that sets the target ablaze.
item.brasshaven.fire_staff.flavor: The tip never quite stops smoking.
item.brasshaven.flippers.desc: Swim much faster (like Depth Strider II).
item.brasshaven.flippers.flavor: Ugly on land, glorious in the sea.
item.brasshaven.forbidden_grimoire.desc: Use: a beam of searing ink that blinds.
item.brasshaven.forge_king_hammer.desc: Use: a molten shockwave that sets foes ablaze.
item.brasshaven.fourth_king_sceptre: Scarab Sceptre of the Fourth King
item.brasshaven.fourth_king_sceptre.desc: Use: loose a scarab along your aim (up to 16 blocks); it bursts into a swarm on the first foe or wall it meets, and the swarm leaps from foe to foe (up to 4 leaps within 5 blocks, a fifth weaker each time), poisoning and starving every foe it bites; you drink 1 health per foe bitten.
item.brasshaven.fourth_king_sceptre.flav: They chiselled away his face and his name; the scarabs remember both.
item.brasshaven.frost_blade.desc: Slows foes; every third hit freezes them.
item.brasshaven.frost_blade.flavor: Its edge is always rimed with ice.
item.brasshaven.frost_staff.desc: Spell (25 mana): a frost nova that freezes and slows foes around you.
item.brasshaven.frost_staff.flavor: Frost creeps along the haft on summer days.
item.brasshaven.frostplate_boots.desc: Set: you never freeze, melee attackers are slowed for 3 s, and Resistance I in cold lands.
item.brasshaven.frostplate_boots.flavor: Forged in the glacier's heart, quenched in meltwater.
item.brasshaven.frostplate_chestplate.de: Set: you never freeze, melee attackers are slowed for 3 s, and Resistance I in cold lands.
item.brasshaven.frostplate_chestplate.fl: Forged in the glacier's heart, quenched in meltwater.
item.brasshaven.frostplate_helmet.desc: Set: you never freeze, melee attackers are slowed for 3 s, and Resistance I in cold lands.
item.brasshaven.frostplate_helmet.flavor: Forged in the glacier's heart, quenched in meltwater.
item.brasshaven.frostplate_leggings.desc: Set: you never freeze, melee attackers are slowed for 3 s, and Resistance I in cold lands.
item.brasshaven.frostplate_leggings.flav: Forged in the glacier's heart, quenched in meltwater.
item.brasshaven.gale_staff.desc: Use: step ahead on a gust, hurling the foes where you land into the air; then drift down slowly and jump higher for 5 s.
item.brasshaven.gale_staff.flavor: Its bell rang at every gate of the climb.
item.brasshaven.gardener_shears: Pruning Shears of the Head Gardener
item.brasshaven.gardener_shears.desc: Use: the blades open and snap shut along your aim (up to 7 blocks, walls stop them): every foe between them is cut, and a foe under half health is pruned for 50% more. Thorns burst round each foe cut, snaring it and the foes next to it, and every cut regrows you 1 health (4 at most).
item.brasshaven.gardener_shears.flavor: Nobody came back to the palm house; he kept pruning, and the garden kept growing into him.
item.brasshaven.gatekeeper_key.desc: Use: turn the key in the floor; stone hands punch up all around you, hurling foes into the air, and the oath wards you (Resistance II, 4 s).
item.brasshaven.gatekeeper_key.flavor: It opened the pass for a thousand years; now it opens skulls.
item.brasshaven.glow_jelly.desc: Dropped by Glow Jellyfish. Brews Night Vision; four around glass make a Jelly Lamp.
item.brasshaven.golden_mace.desc: Use: a golden quake that hurls foes into the air.
item.brasshaven.grappling_hook.desc: Use: fire the claw (32 blocks); it reels you in.
item.brasshaven.grappling_hook.desc2: Sneak or use again: let go.
item.brasshaven.grappling_hook.desc3: No fall damage while reeled in.
item.brasshaven.grappling_hook.flavor: A claw, a chain and a lot of nerve.
item.brasshaven.gryphon_lance.desc: Use: bound forward on the wind, scattering foes.
item.brasshaven.gryphon_lance.flavor: It remembers the wind under great wings.
item.brasshaven.halo_glaive.desc: Use: fling a fan of five halo shards ahead; they pierce every foe in their path and blind it.
item.brasshaven.halo_glaive.flavor: A crescent torn from a broken heaven.
item.brasshaven.halo_locket.desc: Worn: when a blow leaves you under 3 hearts, Regeneration II and Absorption II for 8 s (once every 90 s).
item.brasshaven.halo_locket.flavor: A sliver of the halo, kept against the last fall.
item.brasshaven.healing_staff.desc: Spell (30 mana): heals you and the players around you.
item.brasshaven.healing_staff.flavor: Warm to the touch, like a hand on the shoulder.
item.brasshaven.heart_lodeblade.desc: Use: the engine-heart beats once; every foe you can see within 9 blocks is dragged to within a step of you, hurt (harder the more armour it wears) and slowed for 2 s, and loose items and experience in reach fly to you.
item.brasshaven.heart_lodeblade.flavor: The colossus fell; its heart kept beating and pulled the armour back on.
item.brasshaven.helmsman_anchor.desc: Use: the anchor crashes down and a broadside of bursts tears along the line ahead, setting foes ablaze.
item.brasshaven.helmsman_anchor.flavor: It sank a fleet; now it sinks foes.
item.brasshaven.hierarch_sunstaff.desc: Use: loose a ray of focused sunlight along your aim; it glances off walls, floors and ceilings like light off a mirror (up to 3 bounces, 24 blocks in all), burns every foe it crosses once and grows a quarter hotter with each bounce.
item.brasshaven.hierarch_sunstaff.flavor: He kept the noon for a dead empire; the staff still remembers where the sun stood.
item.brasshaven.hierophant_crozier.desc: Use: swing the lantern toward a spot up to 12 blocks away; the bog opens there, drags every foe within 4 blocks into its heart, holds them fast for 3 s and a poison bloom bursts on them.
item.brasshaven.hierophant_crozier.flavo: His lantern led a whole town into the bog; it still knows the way.
item.brasshaven.ironclad_boots.desc: One of the four pieces of the Ironclad Officer's Plate.
item.brasshaven.ironclad_boots.flavor: Armour plate cut from the ship's own belt, buttons from her brass.
item.brasshaven.ironclad_chestplate.desc: One of the four pieces of the Ironclad Officer's Plate.
item.brasshaven.ironclad_chestplate.flav: Armour plate cut from the ship's own belt, buttons from her brass.
item.brasshaven.ironclad_helmet.desc: One of the four pieces of the Ironclad Officer's Plate.
item.brasshaven.ironclad_helmet.flavor: Armour plate cut from the ship's own belt, buttons from her brass.
item.brasshaven.ironclad_leggings.desc: One of the four pieces of the Ironclad Officer's Plate.
item.brasshaven.ironclad_leggings.flavor: Armour plate cut from the ship's own belt, buttons from her brass.
item.brasshaven.jade_blowpipe.desc: Use: a silent poisoned dart (Poison II, 4 s, and Slowness, 3 s), no ammunition needed, once a second.
item.brasshaven.jade_blowpipe.flavor: Carved from one piece of jade; the frog that tipped its darts is carved on the mouthpiece.
item.brasshaven.jade_fang.desc: Use: pounce forward, tearing through every foe.
item.brasshaven.jade_fang.flavor: Swift as the jungle's last hunter.
item.brasshaven.jailer_chain.desc: Use: hurl the chain ahead; the first foe it catches is dragged to your feet and set ablaze.
item.brasshaven.jarl_axe: Bearded Axe of the Frost Jarl
item.brasshaven.jarl_axe.desc: Use: breathe the jarl's winter; a cone of frost ahead hurts every foe in it and freezes it solid for 2 s.
item.brasshaven.jarl_axe.flavor: The winter he swore to bring never ended.
item.brasshaven.jarl_mantle.desc: Worn: you never freeze, and Resistance I in cold lands.
item.brasshaven.jarl_mantle.flavor: The bear lost; the cold never won either.
item.brasshaven.kings_trident.desc: Use: a tidal ring that slows every foe around you.
item.brasshaven.kings_trident.flavor: The drowned king's sceptre, still dripping.
item.brasshaven.levitation_wand.desc: Spell (20 mana): lifts the creature you aim at. Sneak: slow fall for yourself.
item.brasshaven.levitation_wand.flavor: Light as a feather, and so is its target.
item.brasshaven.light_staff.desc: Use: burst of light that repels monsters.
item.brasshaven.light_staff.flavor: A sunrise kept for the darkest corridors.
item.brasshaven.lithite_shard.desc: A crystal that hums deep underground.
item.brasshaven.lockkeeper_boots.desc: One of the four pieces of the Lock-Keeper's Brass.
item.brasshaven.lockkeeper_boots.flavor: Riveted for the men who walked the channel bed when the sluices were shut.
item.brasshaven.lockkeeper_chestplate.de: One of the four pieces of the Lock-Keeper's Brass.
item.brasshaven.lockkeeper_chestplate.fl: Riveted for the men who walked the channel bed when the sluices were shut.
item.brasshaven.lockkeeper_helmet.desc: One of the four pieces of the Lock-Keeper's Brass.
item.brasshaven.lockkeeper_helmet.flavor: Riveted for the men who walked the channel bed when the sluices were shut.
item.brasshaven.lockkeeper_leggings.desc: One of the four pieces of the Lock-Keeper's Brass.
item.brasshaven.lockkeeper_leggings.flav: Riveted for the men who walked the channel bed when the sluices were shut.
item.brasshaven.lumber_axe.desc: Fells whole trees. Sneak to cut one log.
item.brasshaven.magma_maul.desc: Use: magma bursts from the ground along a line and sets foes ablaze; you shrug off fire for 6 s.
item.brasshaven.magma_maul.flavor: Quarried from the crater wall while the stone was still soft.
item.brasshaven.magmaguard_boots.desc: Set: magma blocks never burn you, melee attackers catch fire for 4 s, and Strength I while you stand in fire or lava.
item.brasshaven.magmaguard_boots.flavor: Basalt plates bolted over a heart of slow magma.
item.brasshaven.magmaguard_chestplate.de: Set: magma blocks never burn you, melee attackers catch fire for 4 s, and Strength I while you stand in fire or lava.
item.brasshaven.magmaguard_chestplate.fl: Basalt plates bolted over a heart of slow magma.
item.brasshaven.magmaguard_helmet.desc: Set: magma blocks never burn you, melee attackers catch fire for 4 s, and Strength I while you stand in fire or lava.
item.brasshaven.magmaguard_helmet.flavor: Basalt plates bolted over a heart of slow magma.
item.brasshaven.magmaguard_leggings.desc: Set: magma blocks never burn you, melee attackers catch fire for 4 s, and Strength I while you stand in fire or lava.
item.brasshaven.magmaguard_leggings.flav: Basalt plates bolted over a heart of slow magma.
item.brasshaven.magnet_ring.desc: Worn in a ring slot and switched on (it glows): pulls items and XP within 7 blocks. Use in hand, or the magnet key: on/off.
item.brasshaven.magnet_ring.flavor: Lodestone set in brass. Loose things find their way home.
item.brasshaven.mana_amulet.desc: Worn in the amulet slot: mana regenerates 50% faster.
item.brasshaven.mana_amulet.flavor: A crystal that drinks the ambient magic.
item.brasshaven.map_fragment.desc: Torn piece of an ancient map. Found in Overworld ruins.
item.brasshaven.master_builder_wand.desc: Use on a block: extend that face by up to 64 blocks. Sneak-use in the air: undo. Sneak-use a block: mirror centre; G: symmetry mode.
item.brasshaven.master_builder_wand.flav: For walls that would take all week.
item.brasshaven.mithril_boots.desc: Set: +4 max health and +10% speed; feather-light.
item.brasshaven.mithril_boots.flavor: Light as silk, hard as a mountain.
item.brasshaven.mithril_chestplate.desc: Set: +4 max health and +10% speed; feather-light.
item.brasshaven.mithril_chestplate.flavo: Light as silk, hard as a mountain.
item.brasshaven.mithril_helmet.desc: Set: +4 max health and +10% speed; feather-light.
item.brasshaven.mithril_helmet.flavor: Light as silk, hard as a mountain.
item.brasshaven.mithril_leggings.desc: Set: +4 max health and +10% speed; feather-light.
item.brasshaven.mithril_leggings.flavor: Light as silk, hard as a mountain.
item.brasshaven.oath_girdle.desc: Worn: +2 hearts of max health and 30% knockback resistance.
item.brasshaven.oath_girdle.flavor: Buckled with the golden key of the toll.
item.brasshaven.oathbreaker.desc: Use: leap forward and crash down, weakening foes; the broken oath fuels you (Strength I, 5 s).
item.brasshaven.oathbreaker.flavor: The giants knelt to swear. This is what they swore on.
item.brasshaven.oblivion_vial.desc: Use: forget every talent and get all your points back.
item.brasshaven.oblivion_vial.flavor: One sip and the lessons are gone.
item.brasshaven.pearl.desc: From a Pearl Oyster. Four pearls trade for an emerald at the crafting table.
item.brasshaven.pharaoh_flail.desc: Use: sand pillars burst along a line and weaken foes.
item.brasshaven.pharaoh_flail.flavor: The desert obeys whoever holds it.
item.brasshaven.piglin_king_spawn_egg: The Golden Piglin King Spawn Egg
item.brasshaven.pilgrim_band.desc: Worn: +10% speed, and a third less fall damage.
item.brasshaven.pilgrim_band.flavor: Worn thin by a thousand steps.
item.brasshaven.pocket_watch.desc: Use: time, day, moon phase and biome.
item.brasshaven.pocket_watch.desc2: Worn on your belt: chimes at dusk and at dawn.
item.brasshaven.pocket_watch.flavor: Wound once, it never loses a minute.
item.brasshaven.pressure_lance.desc: Use: open the nozzle; a high-pressure jet of water shoots 14 blocks along your aim (walls stop it), hurts every foe in it and hurls it to the far end; the recoil pushes you a step back and puts out fire.
item.brasshaven.queen_macuahuitl: Jade Macuahuitl of the Strangler Queen
item.brasshaven.queen_macuahuitl.desc: Use: crack a lash of living root along your aim (up to 14 blocks); the first foe it meets is caged where it stands, held fast for 3 s and weakened, and the cage's thorns whip every other foe within 3 blocks, dragging them against the bars for half damage.
item.brasshaven.queen_macuahuitl.flavor: The fig strangled the temple and crowned itself; its teeth are the temple's jade.
item.brasshaven.recall_scroll.desc: Use: return to the nearest waystone of this dimension.
item.brasshaven.recall_scroll.flavor: Read it aloud and the waystone answers.

item.brasshaven.rimefang_spear.desc: Use: the ice seizes every foe around you, slows them to a crawl and freezes them stiff.
item.brasshaven.rimefang_spear.flavor: The skalds sang that it was cut from the jarl's own frozen tear.
item.brasshaven.rivet_cannon.desc: Use: a blast of five red-hot rivets in a fan ahead (4 damage each), no ammunition needed; the recoil nudges you back.
item.brasshaven.rivet_cannon.flavor: It closed the dam's seams under forty fathoms of water. Flesh gives way more easily.
item.brasshaven.rivet_gun.desc: Use: fire a hot rivet (5 damage).
item.brasshaven.rivet_gun.flavor: Built for hulls, used for everything else.
item.brasshaven.rootmother_staff.desc: Use: roots seize and crush every foe around you.
item.brasshaven.rootmother_staff.flavor: Roots still curl around your fingers.
item.brasshaven.rune_fist.flavor: A colossus's knuckle, runes still glowing.
item.brasshaven.sculk_horn.desc: Use: a sonic blast that pierces everything ahead.
item.brasshaven.sculk_horn.flavor: It hears you before you blow it.
item.brasshaven.sentinel_greatsword.desc: Use: the greatsword cleaves the ground and a crack of rune light tears along the line ahead, hurling foes up.
item.brasshaven.sentinel_greatsword.flav: Bronze that kept a gate for a thousand years.
item.brasshaven.serpent_scale.desc: Trophy of the Sea Serpent. Four make a Diving Helmet.
item.brasshaven.sluice_hook.desc: Use: cast the hook up to 14 blocks: it drags the first foe to your feet, or, if it bites stone, hauls you there. Hits on foes standing in water deal 3 more damage.
item.brasshaven.sluice_hook.flavor: Made to pull drowned logs from the sluice grates. It is not fussy about what it pulls.
item.brasshaven.solar_khopesh.desc: In daylight under the open sky, your hits set foes ablaze, and undead take 3 more damage. Use: flash the blade at the sun to blind the foes ahead (8 blocks); undead among them burn.
item.brasshaven.solar_khopesh.flavor: Its edge was ground on the lens of the sun-engine itself.
item.brasshaven.soul_scythe.desc: Use: reap souls in a wide arc and drink their life.
item.brasshaven.soul_scythe.flavor: It whispers the names it has reaped.
item.brasshaven.starfall_lance.desc: Use: stars fall in a ring around you, hurting and blinding every foe; you move swiftly for 5 s.
item.brasshaven.starfall_lance.flavor: A spoke of the broken halo, still falling.
item.brasshaven.steam_cane.desc: Spell (20 mana): a blast of steam that hurls foes back.
item.brasshaven.steam_cane.flavor: A gentleman's cane with a boiler inside.
item.brasshaven.stoker_shovel.desc: Use: fling a shovelful of soul embers in a fan along your aim (five embers, up to 12 blocks, walls stop them); each bursts on the first foe it meets or where it lands, 1.6 blocks round. A foe caught by one burst takes 60% of the damage, +20% for each more burst that catches it (140% at most), and is set ablaze.
item.brasshaven.stoker_shovel.flavor: He fed the engine souls for a thousand years, and it was never full.
item.brasshaven.storm_staff.desc: Use: call lightning where you look.
item.brasshaven.storm_staff.flavor: The clouds lean closer when it is raised.
item.brasshaven.strangler_queen_spawn_eg: The Strangler Fig Queen Spawn Egg
item.brasshaven.structure_compass.desc: Use: locate the nearest Brasshaven structure. Sneak-use: change target.
item.brasshaven.structure_compass.flavor: It points at old stones, not at the north.
item.brasshaven.sun_priest_boots.desc: One of the four pieces of the Sun-Priest's Regalia.
item.brasshaven.sun_priest_boots.flavor: Polished each dawn so the engine's god would know its servant.
item.brasshaven.sun_priest_chestplate.de: One of the four pieces of the Sun-Priest's Regalia.
item.brasshaven.sun_priest_chestplate.fl: Polished each dawn so the engine's god would know its servant.
item.brasshaven.sun_priest_helmet.desc: One of the four pieces of the Sun-Priest's Regalia.
item.brasshaven.sun_priest_helmet.flavor: Polished each dawn so the engine's god would know its servant.
item.brasshaven.sun_priest_leggings.desc: One of the four pieces of the Sun-Priest's Regalia.
item.brasshaven.sun_priest_leggings.flav: Polished each dawn so the engine's god would know its servant.
item.brasshaven.telluric_hammer.desc: Use: shockwave that knocks enemies back.
item.brasshaven.telluric_hammer.flavor: Lithite rings like a bell when it strikes.
item.brasshaven.thunder_staff.desc: Spell (35 mana): lightning that jumps between up to 4 foes.
item.brasshaven.thunder_staff.flavor: Copper coils and a very short temper.
item.brasshaven.tide_abbess_spawn_egg: The Abbess of the Tides Spawn Egg
item.brasshaven.tide_pendant.desc: Worn: underwater, you breathe freely and gain Conduit Power.
item.brasshaven.tide_pendant.flavor: A pearl that still rises and falls with the tide.
item.brasshaven.tidewarden_boots.desc: Set: breathe underwater, swim faster, and heal half a heart every 4 s while wet (water or rain).
item.brasshaven.tidewarden_boots.flavor: The abbey's wardens walked the causeway at high tide.
item.brasshaven.tidewarden_chestplate.de: Set: breathe underwater, swim faster, and heal half a heart every 4 s while wet (water or rain).
item.brasshaven.tidewarden_chestplate.fl: The abbey's wardens walked the causeway at high tide.
item.brasshaven.tidewarden_helmet.desc: Set: breathe underwater, swim faster, and heal half a heart every 4 s while wet (water or rain).
item.brasshaven.tidewarden_helmet.flavor: The abbey's wardens walked the causeway at high tide.
item.brasshaven.tidewarden_leggings.desc: Set: breathe underwater, swim faster, and heal half a heart every 4 s while wet (water or rain).
item.brasshaven.tidewarden_leggings.flav: The abbey's wardens walked the causeway at high tide.
item.brasshaven.toll_billhook.desc: Use: the hook drags the first foe ahead to your feet and you take your toll of its life; the toll shields you (Absorption I, 6 s).
item.brasshaven.toll_billhook.flavor: Every traveller paid. The ones who did not are still in the hall below.
item.brasshaven.travel_backpack.desc: Use: open 27 extra slots that travel with you.
item.brasshaven.travel_backpack.flavor: Stitched leather, brass buckles, room for one more.
item.brasshaven.turbine_engineer_boots.d: One of the four pieces of the Turbine Engineer's Rig.
item.brasshaven.turbine_engineer_boots.f: Gauges on the wrists, a boiler on the back, nerves of cast iron.

item.brasshaven.tyrant_wrench.desc: Use: open the valve; a blast of scalding steam bursts from you and hurls away every foe you can see within 8 blocks (walls shield them), full force up close, half at the edge, and the overload speeds you up for 3 s.
item.brasshaven.undertow_glaive.desc: Use: ride a wave forward through your foes and slow them; then breathe and swim like a dolphin for 10 s.
item.brasshaven.undertow_glaive.flavor: The tide comes in faster than a horse can gallop.
item.brasshaven.void_boots.desc: Set: slow fall, and the void sends you back instead of killing you.
item.brasshaven.void_boots.flavor: It weighs nothing, and neither do you.
item.brasshaven.void_chestplate.desc: Set: slow fall, and the void sends you back instead of killing you.
item.brasshaven.void_chestplate.flavor: It weighs nothing, and neither do you.
item.brasshaven.void_greatblade.desc: Use: blink ahead and cleave everything around you.
item.brasshaven.void_greatblade.flavor: Cut from the dark between the stars.
item.brasshaven.void_heart.desc: It beats with the rhythm of the void.
item.brasshaven.void_helmet.desc: Set: slow fall, and the void sends you back instead of killing you.
item.brasshaven.void_helmet.flavor: It weighs nothing, and neither do you.
item.brasshaven.void_leggings.desc: Set: slow fall, and the void sends you back instead of killing you.
item.brasshaven.void_leggings.flavor: It weighs nothing, and neither do you.
item.brasshaven.void_shard.desc: A sliver of the space between the End islands.
item.brasshaven.void_spear.desc: Use: blink behind the creature you look at.
item.brasshaven.void_spear.flavor: Its point is never quite where you see it.
item.brasshaven.ward_orb.desc: Spell (40 mana): an arcane shield that absorbs damage.
item.brasshaven.ward_orb.flavor: A storm held in glass, facing outward.
item.brasshaven.warden_tongs: Searing Tongs of the Anvil Warden
item.brasshaven.warden_tongs.desc: Use: seize the nearest foe in front of you (within 4.5 blocks) in the white-hot tongs and hurl it along your aim (up to 10 blocks, walls stop it): every foe it crashes through takes three quarters of the damage, and it slams down at the end, ablaze, scorching every foe within 2.5 blocks for half.
item.brasshaven.warden_tongs.flavor: They held the titan's iron while it was still white; they have never cooled.
item.brasshaven.wayfarer_atlas.desc: Use (or press J): open the quest journal. Sneak-use (or press M): the world map.
item.brasshaven.wayfarer_atlas.flavor: Every road you walk, inked as you go.
item.brasshaven.wayfarer_manual.desc: Use: learn how every Brasshaven system works. Hold the manual key (W) over an item: its page.
item.brasshaven.windrobe_boots.desc: Set: +10% speed, Jump Boost I, and no fall damage from below 12 blocks (halved above).
item.brasshaven.windrobe_boots.flavor: Woven light enough for the wind to carry a pilgrim the last steps.
item.brasshaven.windrobe_chestplate.desc: Set: +10% speed, Jump Boost I, and no fall damage from below 12 blocks (halved above).

npc.brasshaven.greet.druid: The World Tree listens to those who care for the forest. What will you do for it?
npc.brasshaven.greet.dwarf_elder: Hmph. Surface folk. Prove your worth and the deep halls will remember your name.
npc.brasshaven.greet.guild_agent: The Guild always needs a hand. Here is what is pinned on my board today.
npc.brasshaven.greet.scholar: Ah, a traveller! Knowledge hides in dangerous places. Will you help me fetch some?
npc.brasshaven.greet.tinkerer: Mind the gears! I always need parts, and someone brave enough to test my contraptions.
npc.brasshaven.idle.druid: The forest is at peace. Walk softly, friend.
npc.brasshaven.idle.dwarf_elder: You have done the clans proud. The forges sing your name.
npc.brasshaven.idle.guild_agent: No more contracts for you today, wayfarer. The roads are safer thanks to you.
npc.brasshaven.idle.scholar: My notes are complete, for now. Come back when the world has new secrets.
npc.brasshaven.idle.tinkerer: Every gear is in its place. Tick, tock, perfect.
npcquest.brasshaven.druid_gift.descripti: Bring the Druid's seed pouch to a Guild Agent.
npcquest.brasshaven.druid_gift.story: The Guild feeds many mouths. Take them these seeds from the World Tree; they grow anywhere.
npcquest.brasshaven.druid_gift.title: A Gift for the Guild
npcquest.brasshaven.druid_palace.descrip: Find the Sylvan Palace, then come back to a Druid.
npcquest.brasshaven.druid_palace.story: Our sisters of the Sylvan Palace sing under a pale tree. Find them and bring me news of their court.
npcquest.brasshaven.druid_palace.title: The Sylvan Court
npcquest.brasshaven.druid_saplings.descr: Bring 8 Oak Saplings to a Druid.
npcquest.brasshaven.druid_saplings.story: Every tree cut must be given back. Eight oak saplings, and the forest forgives.
npcquest.brasshaven.druid_saplings.title: Seeds of the Forest
npcquest.brasshaven.druid_spiders.descri: Defeat 10 Spiders, then come back to a Druid.
npcquest.brasshaven.druid_spiders.story: Spiders weave over our nests and smother the young leaves. Drive them out of the canopy.
npcquest.brasshaven.druid_spiders.title: Webs in the Branches
npcquest.brasshaven.elder_forge.descript: Find a Dwarven Forge, then come back to a Dwarf Elder.
npcquest.brasshaven.elder_forge.story: Our ancestors had a forge deeper than this city. Find it and tell me if the anvils still ring.
npcquest.brasshaven.elder_forge.title: The Lost Forge
npcquest.brasshaven.elder_iron.descripti: Bring 20 Iron Ingots to a Dwarf Elder.
npcquest.brasshaven.elder_iron.story: The mines run dry and the forges starve. Twenty ingots of iron, surface dweller.
npcquest.brasshaven.elder_iron.title: Iron for the Forges
npcquest.brasshaven.elder_runes.descript: Bring the Elder's rune tablet to a Scholar.
npcquest.brasshaven.elder_runes.story: These runes are older than my clan. Let one of your surface scholars try to read them.
npcquest.brasshaven.elder_runes.title: Runes for the Scholar
npcquest.brasshaven.elder_skeletons.desc: Defeat 12 Skeletons, then come back to a Dwarf Elder.
npcquest.brasshaven.elder_skeletons.stor: The old dead rise in the lower halls and shoot at our miners. Break their bones.
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_bandits.descri: Defeat 8 Pillagers, then report to a Guild Agent.
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_bandits.story: Bandits camp along the plains and rob our couriers. The Guild pays well for every one of them.
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_bandits.title: Bounty: Bandits
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_letter.descrip: Carry the Guild's sealed letter to a Druid of the World Tree.
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_letter.story: The druids of the Hollow Giant Tree have not answered our letters. Bring this one to them in person.
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_letter.title: A Letter for the Druids
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_provisions.des: Bring 12 Bread to a Guild Agent.
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_provisions.sto: Our scouts leave at dawn with empty bags. Twelve loaves would keep them going for a week. Help me, and I will have real survey work for you.
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_roads.descript: Defeat 10 Zombies, then report to a Guild Agent.
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_roads.story: The dead walk the trade roads at night. Thin them out and the caravans will thank you.
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_roads.title: Clear the Roads
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_survey.descrip: Find a Ruined Watchtower (marked on your map), then report to a Guild Agent.
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_survey.story: One of our old watchtowers went silent. I marked the nearest one on your map: go and tell me what is left of it. Do this, and the Guild will trust you with one of its Structure Compasses.
npcquest.brasshaven.guild_survey.title: Survey the Watchtower
npcquest.brasshaven.scholar_books.story: I filled my last notebook last night. Six books, and I can write down everything you will find.
npcquest.brasshaven.scholar_books.title: Blank Pages
npcquest.brasshaven.scholar_library.desc: Find a Forgotten Library, then come back to a Scholar.
npcquest.brasshaven.scholar_library.stor: Somewhere a whole library sank under moss and ink. Find it, and tell me if the shelves still stand.
npcquest.brasshaven.scholar_notes.descri: Bring the Scholar's notes to a Tinkerer.
npcquest.brasshaven.scholar_notes.story: These are drawings of an old clockwork. The tinkerers of the Clockwork Citadel will know what to make of them.
npcquest.brasshaven.scholar_notes.title: Notes for the Tinkerer
npcquest.brasshaven.scholar_wraiths.desc: Defeat 4 Map Wraiths, then come back to a Scholar.
npcquest.brasshaven.scholar_wraiths.stor: Map Wraiths shred every chart they touch. Put a few of them to rest and our maps will stay whole.
npcquest.brasshaven.tinker_copper.descri: Bring 24 Copper Ingots to a Tinkerer.
npcquest.brasshaven.tinker_copper.story: My boilers leak like sieves. Twenty-four copper ingots and they will hold the steam again.
npcquest.brasshaven.tinker_copper.title: Copper for the Boilers
npcquest.brasshaven.tinker_foundry.descr: Find a Geothermal Foundry, then come back to a Tinkerer.
npcquest.brasshaven.tinker_foundry.story: They say a foundry was built on the flank of a volcano. I must know how they tame that heat!
npcquest.brasshaven.tinker_foundry.title: Heat of the Earth
npcquest.brasshaven.tinker_parts.descrip: Bring the Tinkerer's crate of parts to a Dwarf Elder.
npcquest.brasshaven.tinker_parts.story: The dwarves of the deep city ordered pistons for their rails. Mind the stairs, it is heavy.
npcquest.brasshaven.tinker_parts.title: Spare Parts for the Deep
npcquest.brasshaven.tinker_spiders.descr: Defeat 6 Clockwork Spiders, then come back to a Tinkerer.
npcquest.brasshaven.tinker_spiders.story: Some of my clockwork spiders ran off and went feral. Bring them down before they bite someone.
npcquest.brasshaven.tinker_spiders.title: Runaway Spiders
pack.brasshaven.custom_biomes: Brasshaven: Crimson Mire, Volcanic Highlands and Pale Dunes
skill.brasshaven.a_shield.desc: Active (V): absorb 12 damage for 15 seconds. Cooldown 45s.
skill.brasshaven.e_climber.desc: Step up full blocks without jumping.
skill.brasshaven.e_lungs.desc: Hold your breath much longer underwater.
skill.brasshaven.m_overdrive.desc: Active (V): 15 seconds of Haste III and Resistance. Cooldown 60s.
skill.brasshaven.m_tinker.desc: The item in your hand slowly repairs itself (1 point every 20s).
skill.brasshaven.m_tinker_2.desc: The item in your hand repairs faster (1 point every 6s).
skill.brasshaven.w_fury.desc: Active (V): 10 seconds of Strength II and Speed. Cooldown 60s.
skill.brasshaven.w_lifesteal.desc: Melee hits heal you for 8% of the damage dealt.
structure.brasshaven.glacier_hall: Glacier Hall of the Frost Jarls
tip.brasshaven.blood_moon: A Blood Moon rises: monsters are much stronger tonight.
tip.brasshaven.boss_mist: Boss mist: walk through it to start the fight. It seals behind you.
tip.brasshaven.company: Your Company: companions on screen and on the map. O: company screen, /cc: company chat.
tip.brasshaven.compass: The Guild trusts you with a Structure Compass! Right-click: the nearest structure. Sneak: choose which kind.
tip.brasshaven.contract_board: Contracts: the reward is held until someone delivers; the goods arrive by post.
tip.brasshaven.danger: The danger level rose: monsters here are stronger.
tip.brasshaven.duel: Duel: stay in the red ring. Nobody dies; the last blow leaves half a heart.
tip.brasshaven.elite: An Elite! Gold name, hits hard, drops good loot.
tip.brasshaven.emotes: Emotes: Y opens the wheel, keys 1 to 8 play them.
tip.brasshaven.grave: Your belongings wait in a grave where you fell. Right-click it to get them back.
tip.brasshaven.guild_terminal: Terminal: every chest of your base (48 blocks around) in one grid.
tip.brasshaven.map: The minimap shows the land around you. M: world map, H: hide it, Shift + H: its size, Z: zoom, B: ping the spot you look at.
tip.brasshaven.npc: A quest giver! Pick a contract, Accept it, then come back to hand it in.
tip.brasshaven.pneumatic_post: Pneumatic Post: your inbox at every post box. Write to anyone, even offline.
tip.brasshaven.sorting_chest: Sorting chest: it sorts itself and pulls in nearby drops.
tip.brasshaven.trade: Trade: both accept, then 3 seconds pass. Any change cancels the acceptances.
tip.brasshaven.waystone: Waystone discovered! Right-click it any time to travel.
toast.brasshaven.update.title: Brasshaven update available
tooltip.brasshaven.ability.effect.lifest: heals you for 25% of the damage
tooltip.brasshaven.accessory.no_stack: Two identical rings do not add up.
tooltip.brasshaven.accessory.worn: Works only while worn in that slot (next to your armour).
Slowness never takes hold either, and soul sand, honey and sucking mud no longer slow you.
Poison never takes hold of you.
tooltip.brasshaven.colossal.canopy_stalk: Walk into leaves to climb them like a ladder (sneak to hold on).
4 more blocks before falls hurt, and a third less fall damage.
tooltip.brasshaven.colossal.ironclad.fou: Explosions deal half damage to you and no longer throw you about.
tooltip.brasshaven.colossal.lockkeeper.f: Swim like a dolphin, and mine underwater as fast as on land.
tooltip.brasshaven.colossal.sun_priest.f: In daylight under the open sky, your critical hits call down a sun-ray: a third more damage and the foe bursts into flame.
tooltip.brasshaven.colossal.turbine_engi: A sprint-jump vents your back boiler: a steam dash forward (every 4 s).
